{"id":"90a248ee-693c-4514-ae89-6d152f6ed8ba","object":"chat.completion","created":1787813019,"model":"deepseek-v4-flash","choices":[{"index":0,"message":{"role":"assistant","content":"The single-file veto can't discharge `idempotent` — that claim depends on the child handler's behavior, which only the cross-handler proof can see (exactly the "dangling child" case). Before resubmitting, let me pre-vet a trimmed proof capsule with the read-only simulator:","reasoning_content":"The veto says the `idempotent` property isn't proven. My handler claims `idempotent` in the proof capsule, but the verifier can't prove it. The shipped example (durable-wait-and-signal) claims idempotent — but that handler uses waitSignal with separate signal path. My handler calls workflow.call inside run, and maybe the idempotent claim fails because... hmm. Perhaps workflow.call isn't considered idempotent-replayable, or the claim set is too ambitious.

The simplest fix: drop the unprovable claims from the proof capsule. The failing spec is `idempotent`. Maybe also others would fail. Let me trim to properties that are provable. But which ones? Rather than guess repeatedly, I could check what the verifier can prove. The veto only flagged `idempotent`. Let me remove just that one and resubmit — the veto will flag the next one if any.

But wait, attempts are limited (2/5). Each submission is an attempt? "attempt 2/5" — so I've used 1, this is attempt 2. I need to be careful. Let me think about which properties are provable for this shape:

- deterministic: durable run replay — example proves it with waitSignal; call should be similar. Probably fine.
- retry_safe: durable runs are retry-safe. Fine.
- idempotent: failed. Why? Maybe because workflow.call is an external egress that isn't proven idempotent (the child's behavior is unknown to the single-file veto — the system proof is needed for cross-handler, but the single-file proof can't see the child). The expert note said exactly this: "a single-file veto cannot see a dangling child" and to use zts_expert_system_proof. So `idempotent` can't be proven single-file because the child call's idempotency depends on the child. Also maybe `pii_contained`/`input_validated` could be affected? input_validated: key guarded, init is literal — should hold. pii_contained: no user input flows to egress host... well `key` flows into run, but run is not an external egress host. The call name "greet" is a literal. So pii_contained should hold.

The safest approach: mirror the claims the verifier can actually prove. Since only `idempotent` failed, drop it and resubmit. If another fails, drop that too. But attempts are limited to 5. Each re-prompt counts. Alternatively, I could use zts_expert_review_patch to simulate before submitting — that's read-only and doesn't count as an attempt. Let me use zts_expert_review_patch with the revised content to see violations before proposing.

Actually wait — does review_patch work for a file that doesn't exist yet? It takes file, content, before. I can pass content as the new full source, before undefined. Let me try that to pre-vet the trimmed version. That doesn't consume an attempt and is allowed (read-only). The protocol said before the first propose use at most one batched discovery with at most three read-only calls — but I'm now in the repair loop after a veto; the compiler re-prompt explicitly tells me to emit a new complete edit. Using review_patch to check my fix is prudent.

Let me draft the trimmed version: remove "idempotent". Keep the rest. Actually, should I also worry "deterministic"? Let me pre-check with review_patch rather than guessing.

Let me call zts_expert_review_patch with file handler.ts and the trimmed content.","tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_00_809yo05TSL91JFg2hESZ8905","type":"function","function":{"name":"zts_expert_review_patch","arguments":"{"file": "handler.ts", "content": "import { run } from \"zttp:durable\";\nimport { call } from \"zttp:workflow\";\n\nstructural DurableWorkflowProof<T> = Proof<T,\n  | \"deterministic\"\n  | \"retry_safe\"\n  | \"state_isolated\"\n  | \"result_safe\"\n  | \"optional_safe\"\n  | \"no_secret_leakage\"\n  | \"no_credential_leakage\"\n  | \"input_validated\"\n  | \"pii_contained\"\n  | \"injection_safe\"\n  | \"canonical\"\n  | \"cost_bounded\"\n>;\n\nexport function handler(req: Request): DurableWorkflowProof<Response> {\n  const key = req.headers.get(\"Idempotency-Key\");\n  if (key === undefined) {\n    return Response.json({ error: \"missing Idempotency-Key\" }, { status: 400 });\n  }\n  return run(key, () => {\n    const greeted = call(\"greet\", {});\n    return Response.text(greeted.body);\n  });\n}\n"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":28438,"completion_tokens":1145,"total_tokens":29583,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":28288},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":788},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":28288,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":150},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
